description: Requests a presigned URL for uploading a large deep-report reference file (csv, doc, docx, gif, jpg, jpeg, pdf, png, txt, webp, xls, xlsx) directly to storage. This server never proxies file bytes: the caller must PUT the file to the returned signedUrl, capture the x-amz-version-id response header from that PUT, and then call smi_confirm_upload with that version to persist the upload record.
name: smi_request_upload_url
title: Request Deep Report Upload URL
